payload.posture: Read Romans 5:1–11 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peace, suffering, love, and reconciliation. Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ; Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
